notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood Hosted API during 30-day trial; now moving toward Dedicated capacity POC. Trial gave quick validation of response quality and basic telemetry, but product team wants forecasted capacity and price predictability before commit.

Trial metrics observed (hosted API):
- Duration: 2025-10-03 -> 2025-10-31 (trial credits used)
- Average QPS observed (baseline): 6 QPS steady across 9-5 PT internal users
- Peak QPS observed: 42 QPS (two spikes during release window)
- Average request size: 620 tokens (prompt+expected completion)
- Token mix (by request count): ~25% short (<32 tokens), ~60% mid (32-512 tokens), ~15% long (>1024 tokens)
- 95th pct latency (hosted): 220ms for short-turn chat, 700-1,200ms for long-form completion under peak load
- Error rate: <0.3% transient timeouts (mostly during 2 peak spikes)

Requirements / ask from Lakewatcher:
- Dedicated baseline sizing: support steady 20 QPS with room to burst 3-4x during product events (target peak ~80 QPS)
- Concurrency goal: sustain 120 concurrent token-generating streams with 99th latency <250ms for <512-token completions
- Cost sensitivity: want predictable per-token cost and a committed monthly price band (target $75k-200k ARR)
- Security: SOC2 is required, SSO (SAML) + SCIM for user provisioning, KMS integration for key management, and audit logs retained 12 months
- Data residency: primary region NA, but logs/telemetry need EU residency options for EU customers

POC asks for Dedicated evaluation:
- 14-day Dedicated trial with traffic mirroring from hosted production and synthetic ramp to projected peak patterns
- Redwood to provide throughput guidelines (QPS -> recommended GPU count) and a cost model calculator for token mix
- Support ask: SE-led runbook for autoscaling thresholds and failover policies; test fallbacks to smaller quantized model variants

Commercial / pricing notes:
- Lakewatcher expects committed capacity pricing (monthly) with clear bursting policy; prefer blended per-token for hosted fallback routes
- Budget range communicated by CRO: $75k-$200k ARR; CFO insisting on a 12-month predictable cap

Quotes / call snippets: "we can absorb some latency for long-form exports but chat responsiveness is business-critical" — Head of Product (Maya Ortiz).
"If Redwood can show a straightforward mapping from observed trial QPS/token mix to a recommended Dedicated footprint and clear TCO, we move to procurement" — CTO (Evan Park).

Recent technical notes (from SE call):
- Observed KV cache hit rate ~18% on repeated prompts; believe prefix caching could reduce token cost ~12-18%
- Typical completion lengths vary by user cohort (support agents shorter; analytics exports much longer) -> need routing policy by use-case

Next steps (short):
- Jordan to send Dedicated POC proposal and slot for security kickoff (target week of 2025-11-10).
- SE (Priya) to produce a QPS->GPU sizing doc and synthetic load ramp script by 2025-11-07.
- Legal to exchange NDA + data residency addendum; ask: sample DPA and KMS spec.

Open blockers:
- Need more precise QPS forecast from Lakewatcher product analytics team (current model-based forecast varies by 2x+)
- Procurement needs clear SLA on latency percentiles and a maximum overage billing rate for bursts

Misc links and refs: drive proposal, Fireflies notes (ff_20251021_0842), internal pricing spreadsheet reference (drive:/Redwood/Pricing/lakewatcher-blended.xlsx).
